instruction: Tool paths: Revit 2025: C:\Program Files\Autodesk\Revit 2025\Revit.exe; Archicad 27: C:\Program Files\Graphisoft\Archicad 27\Archicad Starter.exe; Abaqus 2025: C:\SIMULIA\EstProducts\2025\win_b64\resources\install\cmdDirFeature\launcher.bat. Open Revit 2025, Archicad 27, or Abaqus CAE from the corresponding desktop shortcut, according to the tool you choose for the task. Revit 2025, Archicad 27, and Abaqus 2025 are available at the paths listed above. Choose an appropriate tool from these three to complete the task. Add Windows to Exterior Wall Shell. Start from the provided init.ifc by opening it in the selected application. The init model is a relevant but incomplete predecessor; clean, complete, rename, subdivide, or add BIM elements as requested instead of replacing it with unrelated geometry. Build or edit the model using real BIM elements such as Walls, Slabs, Zones, Doors, Windows, Roofs, and Stairs where required; use real BIM elements rather than visual-only detail geometry where the task requires model elements. Save the completed model deliverable into `C:\Users\user\Desktop\result` using the selected application's built-in export or Save As IFC workflow. Export the complete model as IFC4 and include the Zones/Spaces in the export. The init model contains a simple two-room shell with few or no windows. Add at least three real windows to exterior walls while preserving Zones named WORK ROOM and STORE. The exported IFC should contain Zones exported as IfcSpace entries named WORK ROOM, STORE. It should contain at least 1 building storey, at least 2 IfcSpace zones, at least 5 wall-like IfcWall or IfcWallStandardCase elements, at least 1 IfcSlab element, at least 2 IfcDoor elements, at least 3 IfcWindow elements. The shaped model should have an overall size roughly matching X span 10 m, Y span 5 m, and Z span 3 m. The IFC should have unique GlobalId values for IfcRoot objects. Other exact coordinates, room proportions, wall thicknesses, opening positions, materials, library part names, property sets, layers, relationship nesting, and harmless exporter metadata may vary as long as the saved result.ifc satisfies the stated BIM content.
